name: cutbolt
description: Local video editing engine for agents: exact timelines, saved sessions, rendering and FFmpeg export.
long_description: Edit local video with exact timelines, saved sessions, previews, captions and rendering. Runs locally over stdio with no network at runtime. This bundle is for Windows x64. Media inspection, rendering and export need FFmpeg and ffprobe installed separately on PATH, or selected with CUTBOLT_FFMPEG and CUTBOLT_FFPROBE. Choose an existing workspace folder for media, outputs and .cutbolt state.

tools.name: cutbolt_preview_sheet
tools.description: Write a contact sheet of exact timeline frames and return it as an inline image.

tools.name: cutbolt_preview_cuts
tools.description: Review cuts as before-and-after frame sheets with clip and source times.

tools.name: cutbolt_audio_normalize
tools.description: Measure the mix and propose clip levels and limiting for a loudness target.

tools.name: cutbolt_audio_tighten
tools.description: Find speech pauses and propose checked ripple deletions across tracks.

tools.name: cutbolt_audio_beats
tools.description: Find music onsets, tempo alternatives and a beat grid at exact file times.

tools.name: cutbolt_audio_duck
tools.description: Analyze speech and propose gain curves that lower music beneath it.

tools.name: cutbolt_media_sheet
tools.description: Show source footage as an inline frame sheet without adding it to a project.

tools.name: cutbolt_export_inspect
tools.description: Inspect timeline timing, sources and policies for an export without writing it.

tools.name: cutbolt_transcript_assemble
tools.description: Turn transcript word selections into checked sequential clip append operations.

tools.name: cutbolt_transcript_fillers
tools.description: Find spoken filler words and propose checked timeline deletions.

tools.name: cutbolt_captions_draft
tools.description: Draft timed caption cues from transcripts of the timeline's sources.

tools.name: cutbolt_scene_inspect
tools.description: Validate a bounded scene and report its source, timing, color and audio policies.

tools.name: cutbolt_scene_still
tools.description: Render one scene frame to a new PNG and return it as an inline image.

tools.name: cutbolt_preview_frame
tools.description: Export one exact timeline frame to a new PNG and return it as an inline image.

tools.name: cutbolt_capabilities
tools.description: Discover implemented editing operations, render profiles, job limits and unsupported features.

tools.name: cutbolt_schema
tools.description: Read the JSON Schema for a command or shared type, with selectable details.

tools.name: cutbolt_project_create
tools.description: Create an empty versioned project snapshot with exact rational timing without saving it.

tools.name: cutbolt_session_create
tools.description: Start a saved project at revision zero with retry-safe request receipts.

tools.name: cutbolt_session_get
tools.description: Read the saved project head or a chosen immutable revision.

tools.name: cutbolt_session_apply
tools.description: Commit an atomic editing batch against an expected revision with a durable request ID.

tools.name: cutbolt_session_undo
tools.description: Undo the latest applied state as a new revision while preserving history.

tools.name: cutbolt_session_preview
tools.description: Inspect an edit's before-and-after placements, tracks, links and durations without saving.

tools.name: cutbolt_session_history
tools.description: Read paginated revision summaries in newest-first order.

tools.name: cutbolt_job_status
tools.description: Read saved job state, progress, attempt history and the completion or error receipt.

tools.name: cutbolt_job_start
tools.description: Queue a long-running command in the background and return a durable ticket.

tools.name: cutbolt_job_wait
tools.description: Wait for one or more jobs and return their status, progress and results.

tools.name: cutbolt_timeline_meters
tools.description: Measure timeline loudness, sample peaks and RMS without exporting.

tools.name: cutbolt_timeline_check
tools.description: Find likely timeline mistakes such as flash frames, sync problems and missing media without rendering.

tools.name: cutbolt_timeline_outline
tools.description: Read a compact timeline outline with clip spans, transitions and optional transcript words.

tools.name: cutbolt_files_list
tools.description: List workspace files and folders with sizes and relative paths, skipping engine state folders.

tools.name: cutbolt_media_inspect
tools.description: Probe a local source's identity, streams and timeline readiness or conversion needs.

tools.name: cutbolt_run
tools.description: Run another Cutbolt tool command by name with its usual arguments.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Choose an existing folder. Cutbolt reads media and writes outputs only inside this folder, and creates a .cutbolt folder here for sessions, jobs, cache and scratch state.
